name: Movie night
author: OmarchyTV
description: Your Home Assistant scenes on one page: lights down for a film with one OK, and an agent that can set the mood for you.

data.text: Ask your agent: "make it movie night for two". It picks the scene, dims Ambilight and opens the app.

agent: For "movie night" (or a similar mood): tv_ha_list scenes, pick the one that fits (or say none fits), run it with tv_ha_run, and open the app the owner names with tv_open or a shortcut. Ask before anything that unlocks, opens or heats.
